title: 装甲疾驰
desc: 2D 机甲动作游戏，原型为 Chrome 小恐龙与装甲核心 6。单人指挥 AI 完成全部开发，开源可试玩。
descEn: A 2D mech action game prototyped on the Chrome dino and Armored Core 6. Built solo by directing AI. Open source and playable.
detail:
横版 2D 机甲动作游戏，原型为 Chrome 小恐龙与装甲核心 6：滑行、飞翔、射击与斩击。单人开发——AI 承担实现，本人负责玩法设计、技术路线、资产管线与全部验收。当前完成度较高，已开源可试玩。

开发分四条线。玩法由本人设计，AI 完成架构与实现，逐步迭代。美术由 LLM 生成 SVG 资产，角色预先拆分可动关节，背景按图层分离。特效要求 AI 基于 Godot 粒子系统实现。音效由 AI 脚本合成，本人逐条试听筛选。关卡在预先制定的设计规范下由 AI 批量生成。

管线的核心是美术与特效的生产规范。AI 自审只能排除部分问题，最终质量仍依赖人工验收。流程为：先由 AI 提出场景风格提案，单一场景定稿后，其余场景按同一规格批量生产，规范随迭代持续修订。验收以实际游玩为主，另建特效展示场景用于专项检查。由此沉淀出三项规范：背景明度过高时子弹不可读，场景整体降低明度；特效需与子弹资产匹配，在子弹消失瞬间完成衔接；关节旋转轴向存在偏差时，进入场景手动校正。

后续仍计划扩展内容。
detailEn:
A side-scrolling 2D mech action game prototyped on the Chrome dino and Armored Core 6: sliding, flying, shooting and slashing. A solo project — AI handled implementation; I owned game design, the technical roadmap, the asset pipeline, and all acceptance. Fairly complete and open source.

Development ran on four tracks. Gameplay designed by me, architected and implemented by AI, iterating step by step. Art: SVG assets generated by LLMs, with characters pre-split into movable joints and backgrounds separated by layer. VFX: AI instructed to build on Godot's particle system. Sound effects synthesized by AI scripts, filtered by ear. Levels were mass-produced by AI under design specs defined up front.

The core of the pipeline was the production spec for art and VFX. AI self-review only catches part of the problems; final quality still depends on human acceptance. The process: AI proposes scene style concepts first; once one scene is locked, the rest are mass-produced to the same spec, with the spec continuously revised through iteration. Acceptance was mostly playing the game myself, plus a dedicated VFX showcase scene for focused checks. Three rules came out of it: when background brightness hurt bullet readability, scenes were dimmed overall; VFX had to match the bullet assets and cover the instant a bullet vanishes; joints with wrong pivot axes were corrected manually in the scene.

Further content is still planned.

title: 相位协议
desc: 30 天 Game Jam 的 FPS 跑酷：协议特工登陆外星地表定位矿脉，传送位移配合作战。
descEn: A 30-day game jam FPS parkour: a protocol agent lands on an alien surface to locate ore veins, teleporting through parkour and combat.
detail:
Tripo Game Jam S1 团队作品，30 天内用 UE 5 完成。玩家扮演协议特工，第一人称登陆外星地表：定位矿脉、部署信标，用传送能力跑酷与战斗。

我负责玩法程序与手感打磨：传送位移、射击与用户控件；另做角色绑定与动画、场景资产的 AI 生成与整合，以及 UI 绘制与关卡设计。

当时当作 UE 入门的练手项目，第一次完整走通蓝图玩法、绑定动画到打包发布的流程。
detailEn:
A team entry for Tripo Game Jam S1, built in 30 days on UE 5. Playing a protocol agent landing on an alien surface in first person: locate ore veins, deploy beacons, and use teleportation to parkour and fight.

I owned gameplay programming and game feel — teleport movement, shooting and user widgets — plus character rigging and animation, AI-generated scene assets and their integration, and UI drawing and level design.

I treated it as an onboarding project for Unreal: my first complete pass from Blueprint gameplay and rigging/animation to packaging and shipping.

title: 太阳系航行模拟
desc: Processing 创意编程课程作品：开普勒轨道力学驱动的航天器发射与行星际转移模拟。
descEn: A Processing creative-coding course project: a spacecraft launch and interplanetary transfer simulation driven by Keplerian orbital mechanics.
detail:
从发射台点火、重力转弯、PEG 圆化进入近地轨道，到霍曼转移奔赴其他行星、被目标捕获——完整任务流程都建立在真实轨道力学上：开普勒方程解析传播、大气指数密度模型、KSP 风格的影响球（SOI）自动切换参考系。

美术全部程序化生成：无外部资源，天体按屏幕半径分四级 LOD 渲染，木星条纹与大红斑、土星三层星环的正确遮挡、太阳日珥脉动都由代码绘制；时间加速带三重保护，保证关键事件不被跳过。

制导算法与轨道传播分离的 KSP 式分层架构，燃料与多级火箭等复杂度刻意留白，专注于实时可视化的表现力。
detailEn:
From pad ignition, gravity turn and PEG circularization into LEO, to a Hohmann transfer toward another planet and capture — the full mission runs on real orbital mechanics: analytic Kepler propagation, an exponential atmosphere model, and KSP-style spheres of influence that switch reference frames automatically.

All visuals are procedural: no external assets. Bodies render across four LOD tiers by on-screen radius; Jupiter's bands and Great Red Spot, Saturn's three-layer rings with correct occlusion, and the Sun's pulsing prominences are all drawn in code. Time acceleration carries triple safeguards so no critical event gets skipped.

A KSP-style layered architecture separates guidance from orbit propagation; fuel and multi-stage rockets are deliberately out of scope to keep the focus on expressive real-time visualization.

title: 元素面具人
desc: 48 小时 Game Jam 跑酷解谜闯关，切换元素面具获得能力、变更阵营躲避敌人。带两位零基础队友完成。
descEn: A 48-hour game jam parkour puzzler: swap masks to gain abilities and change faction to slip past enemies. Led two first-time teammates.
detail:
Global Game Jam 2026 团队作品，48 小时内用 UE5 完成。跑酷解谜闯关：切换元素面具获得元素能力，同时变更阵营躲避敌人。两位队友零基础，由我带着做。

程序用 UE 蓝图：面向对象的抽象与类继承，角色类、机关类各成体系，另配管理器与关卡重置；思路清晰，做得很快，结构干净。建模用简单几何体拼出角色与道具；材质做统一的发光效果，贯穿敌人、道具与机关；特效有胜利彩带、近战斩击、魔法炮弹。

最难是建模：不擅长形体抽象，角色形象折腾很久也建不出来，最后是球脑袋加圆柱身子，前后无法辨认，挂了个箭头组件示意朝向。

比赛结束后没有再动，停留在 demo 状态。回头先重做关卡：教学关很弱、第一关过难，缺少合理引导。
detailEn:
A team entry for Global Game Jam 2026, built in 48 hours on UE5. A parkour puzzler: swapping elemental masks grants abilities and switches faction to slip past enemies. Two first-time teammates, led by me.

Programming in UE Blueprints: object-oriented abstraction and class inheritance, character and mechanism classes in their own hierarchies, plus a manager and level reset; clear plan, fast to build, clean structure. Characters and props modeled from simple geometry; a shared glow material across enemies, props and mechanisms; VFX for victory confetti, melee slashes and magic projectiles.

Modeling was the hardest: shape abstraction isn't my strength, and the character never came together no matter how long I tried — it ended as a sphere head on a cylinder body with no readable front or back, with an arrow component to show the facing.

Untouched since the jam, still a demo. If picked up again, the levels get rebuilt first: a weak tutorial, an overtuned first level, little real guidance.

title: 回音浪人
desc: 7 天 Game Jam 两人合作的解谜游戏：指挥武士借地形回音发动特殊能力，击败敌人。
descEn: A 7-day game jam puzzle game by two people: command a ronin, turn terrain echoes into special abilities, and take enemies down.
detail:
7 天 Game Jam 两人合作的解谜游戏：玩家指挥武士角色行动，利用地形回音发动的特殊能力打败敌人。

两人分工补全整条生产线：我负责玩法功能与关卡设计，把回音机制落成可解的谜题铺排，另做角色的绑定与动画。
detailEn:
A puzzle game from a 7-day game jam, built by two people: the player commands a ronin, using special abilities driven by terrain echoes to defeat enemies.

Two of us split the pipeline between us. I owned gameplay features and level design, turning the echo mechanic into solvable puzzle layouts, plus character rigging and animation.

title: 归鞘
desc: 2.5D 横版冒险，AI 手写 SVG 矢量图当 3D 精灵，立体拼装成场景。个人 + AI 开发。
descEn: A 2.5D side-scrolling adventure; AI hand-writes SVG vector art used as 3D sprites, assembled into scenes. Built solo with AI.
detail:
个人 + AI 开发的 2.5D 横版冒险，玩法近乎走路模拟器：操控角色在城市里观光，遭遇敌人时战斗全自动进行，没有操作，看就好。

玩法由本人设计并迭代，视觉风格由本人定调；场景由 AI 手写 SVG 矢量图，作 3D 精灵立体组装成 2.5D 场景，矢量画风打 3D 灯光。

2.5D 场景是最难也最得意的部分：这种做法没有常见先例，AI 很容易做偏，装配状况不断。对策是制定并迭代生成规范：要求 AI 自己算几何，摄像机能看到的每个面都必须覆盖；验收直接玩直接看，AI 修不动的场景手动挪移调整。

人物与特效同为 AI 生成：人物迭代数版不满意，接受能看的版本继续推进；特效未逐一核对。项目现状是搁置——本为摸索管线而做，想继续时再产场景或调玩法。
detailEn:
Built solo with AI: a 2.5D side-scrolling adventure, close to a walking simulator — you walk the character around the city sightseeing; combat runs fully automatically. Nothing to operate, just watch.

Gameplay designed and iterated by me; visual style set by me; scenes hand-written by AI as SVG vector art, used as 3D sprites assembled into 2.5D scenes with a vector-art look and 3D lights.

The 2.5D scenes were the hardest and proudest part: no common precedent for the approach, so the AI drifts easily and assembly kept hitting problems. The answer was a generation spec, defined and iterated: the AI runs its own geometry checks, every face the camera can see must be covered; acceptance was playing and looking, and scenes the AI couldn't fix I moved by hand.

Characters and VFX were AI-generated too: several rounds of characters still unsatisfying, so a presentable version went in; VFX not checked one by one. Shelved now — the project existed to probe the pipeline; more scenes or a gameplay pass when I pick it up again.

title: 游戏之梦
desc: 48 小时 Game Jam 三人小队的动作闯关：在办公室、机房与战场之间，讲一个做游戏的梦。
descEn: A 48-hour game jam action game by a three-person team: office, server room and battlefield, telling a dream of making games.
detail:
48 小时 Game Jam 三人小队作品。简单的动作闯关，讲一个程策美三人小队追逐做游戏梦想的故事：关卡从办公室、服务器机房一路打到战场。

我负责玩法功能的程序开发：角色操控、战斗与关卡流程的实现，48 小时内完成可玩版本。
detailEn:
A 48-hour game jam entry by a three-person team. A simple action game about a trio of programmer, designer and artist chasing the dream of making games — levels run from the office and the server room to a battlefield.

I handled gameplay programming: character control, combat and level flow, finished into a playable build within 48 hours.

title: 剑与缘
desc: 社团生活 galgame：两位看板娘，自研网页视觉小说引擎，AI 全线生产，线上可试玩。
descEn: A club-life visual novel starring two club heroines, on a self-built web VN engine, produced end to end by directing AI. Playable online.
detail:
社团生活题材的 galgame：以剑道部与兵击部两位看板娘为主角，还原社团日常活动与氛围。网页视觉小说引擎按我的需求开发，部署成静态网站，线上可试玩；程序、剧情、美术全线由我指挥 AI 完成。

程序线：提需求开发网页视觉小说引擎。剧情线：制定主角人设与社团事实锚点，AI 在锚点上发展编写剧情，人工逐篇审核核对事实——事实错误会让熟悉社团的人出戏，这一层必须把住。

美术线分三路：校园场景实拍后交 AI 做风格转换当背景图；配角立绘直接 AI 设计绘制，不做差分；主角立绘从原画师的表情差分出发，制定编辑工作流，由 AI 生产姿势差分，铺开表情×姿势的差分矩阵，全部人工验收。

最难也最得意的是主角立绘差分矩阵：对同一张脸反复做 AI 编辑，画风会持续偏移，几轮之后明显「AI 味」，不再像原来的角色。解法是「去头参考图」——从原画到最终差分只做最多一次 AI 编辑，单次生成不让偏移累加，把原画画风保住。

目前 demo 可玩，仍在持续润色。
detailEn:
A club-life visual novel starring the heroines of the kendo club and the HEMA club, recreating everyday club activities and atmosphere. The web visual-novel engine was built to my requirements and deployed as a static site, playable online; program, story and art were all produced by directing AI.

Programming: specifying and directing the web VN engine. Story: I defined the heroines' profiles and fact anchors for the clubs; the AI developed the script on top of them, and I reviewed every scene against the facts — factual errors would break immersion for anyone who actually knows the clubs, so this layer had to hold.

Art ran on three tracks: campus locations were photographed, then style-transferred by AI into backgrounds; side characters were designed and drawn directly by AI, with no variants; the heroines' sprites started from the original artist's expression sheets — I defined an editing workflow, the AI produced pose variants, laying out an expression × pose matrix, all human-reviewed.

The hardest and proudest part is the heroine sprite matrix: repeated AI edits of the same face drift the art style further each round, until it clearly reads as AI and stops looking like the original character. The fix was a "headless reference sheet": at most one AI edit from the original art to the final variant — a single generation pass, so drift never accumulates and the original style holds.

A playable demo is online; polish is ongoing.
